messages:
leah: dropped a small prototype for the "notification preview card" inside the SLO edit flyout. two quick decisions: label for temporary suppression and how preview announces changes to AT.

tom: visual first: i prefer a slim summary row at top ("2 channels, 1 paused") then each channel expands. keeps the preview compact.

nina: for the label i think "Pause notifications" reads well in product language. it's actionable and less technical than "suppress".

harry: agree "Pause" is friendlier. but we should keep aria text explicit, e.g. aria-label="Pause Email channel (suppress alerts for 1 hour)".

sophia: accessibility nit: when a user pauses multiple channels at once, don't fire a separate live announcement per channel. announce a single summary: "Notifications paused for 3 channels".

a11y-bot: Recommendation: use aria-live="polite" on the summary region and avoid individual per-row live regions. Use concise phrasing (e.g., "Notifications paused for Email until 14:00"). Also ensure the preview is role="region" with aria-labelledby referencing the summary.

leah: great. another micro-ux: long channel names overflow. proposal: truncate at ~28 chars, show an accessible full-name on hover/focus via aria-describedby. add channel icon to help visual scanning.

tom: dev note: collapsing descriptions by default and lazy-rendering expanded rows helps perf for orgs with many channels.

nina: copy tweak: context menu item should read "Pause channel" not "Mute". in the flyout primary CTA is "Save" as usual.

harry: keyboard: when opening the preview with the preview shortcut, focus should land on the summary badge, then pressing Tab goes to first toggle. don't trap focus in a way that prevents Esc to close.

sophia: color/contrast: paused badge currently uses pale blue text on white. bump to dark text on light fill and include a small pause icon (visually hidden label for screen readers).

a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) summary role=region + polite live; 2) aria-labels include channel + state + duration; 3) truncated names exposed via aria-describedby; 4) summary count announced once; 5) keyboard focus order matches visual order.

leah: i'll update the figma to show: top summary, per-row microbadges, truncated accessible names, "Pause" primary microcopy, and a small cost-estimate line under preview. will post link for final pass. thanks! :sparkles:
